summary: Steep residential street, homes 14-19 m away on both sides.
reasons: Narrow street, parked cars on far side

drivers.seclusion: Houses line both sides within 15-20 m; no bush, park or industry backing.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow sealed street; west side has a few parked cars, little clear room beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Quiet residential street joining a busier road at the south end.
drivers.convention: Ordinary residential kerb; no campervans seen.

flags: Dwellings 14-19 m from the kerb all along
sun_shade: Street trees shade patches along the east side; open to afternoon sun from the west.
